name: Mingtong Gu
reason: Health rule (borderline, owner may want to look): his own site chicenter.com (home, Master Mingtong, contact and Path Mastery membership pages, read 6 Nov 2026) sells Wisdom Healing Qigong largely on healing: the home page says chronic disease is caused by stress and offers to 'Heal Your Body', the about page cites a 'medicine-less' hospital healing 'incurable' diseases with a 95 percent improvement rate, the membership page tells of his asthma, scoliosis and back pain lifting, and the YouTube channel (@WisdomHealingQigong, 45.7K) mixes teaching with illness-recovery testimonials and items such as 'Sound Healing For Congestion & Voice Loss'. Some offerings are clean (Pure Consciousness Qigong Immersion, 30-Day Embodied Awakening Retreat near Santa Fe; general inbox Support@ChiCenter.com), but the work as presented is centred on healing claims, so skipped under the strict health rule.
